result_text:
`analyzeLandscape` is added as a second name for `updateLandscape`, with the same options and behaviour. The `cli` module compiles and its tests pass, but I could not run the jar, so the help output and the `<folder>/_sokrates_landscape` output are unverified.

Changes (not committed):
- **`Commands.java`**: new `ANALYZE_LANDSCAPE` constant and its description, which calls it the landscape counterpart of the analysis commands and the same as `updateLandscape`. `usageInfo()` lists it right after `updateLandscape`. `updateLandscape` and its description are untouched.
- **`CommandLineInterface.java`**: `run` sends `analyzeLandscape` to the existing `updateLandscape(args)` method. Its `-help` branch prints the usage under whichever name was typed.

Running the jar needed an approval I didn't have, so I did not check the `-help` output or an end-to-end run.

The README has no command descriptions at all; it only covers build and Docker. I left it alone rather than add a new section. If you want a command list there, say so and I'll add one.
